howto: Pick a piece from the toolbar (Road, House, Tree or Car), then click or tap the grass to place it.
Lay roads first: houses add 4 people each, and cars only drive on road tiles.
Work through the six goals on the left; finishing them all shows your city's results.
Right-click or X removes a piece, R or the mouse wheel turns it, WASD or a one-finger drag moves the camera.
tips: Houses score 5 points, trees 2, roads and cars 1 each.
Put roads down in loops so the cars have somewhere to go.
Your city saves as you build, so you can close the page and carry on later.
The sun rises and sets as you build: each day lasts a minute and a half.
Quality: Low turns off shadows and anti-aliasing if the game runs slowly.

controls.keyboard: 1-4 pick Road, House, Tree or Car; click to place; right-click or X removes; R or the mouse wheel rotates; WASD pans the camera. Enter or Space starts from the title.
controls.touch: Tap the toolbar to pick a piece and tap the ground to place it; drag with one finger to move the camera.

difficulty: A relaxed sandbox with no way to lose: six goals grow from 10 roads to 60 people and 200 points.

cheats.effect: A ready-made block of roads, houses and trees appears
Ten more cars drive onto your roads
Every tree grows to twice its size

settings.quality: Quality button in the top bar: High (shadows, anti-aliasing) or Low

features.autosave: The city (every piece, cars, score, goals, day and camera) saves a moment after each change and on exit
features.goals-or-quests: Six goals on the left with live progress: roads, houses, trees, cars, population and score
features.day-time-ui: Day and clock in the top bar; the sun moves across the sky and dims at night
features.inventory: The top bar counts what the city holds: score, population, buildings and cars
features.tutorial: A four-step guided first build (road, house, tree, car) with Skip; Replay tutorial in the arcade menu runs it again
features.results: City complete card when all six goals are done, with score, population and day, plus Keep building or New city
features.restart: Restart clears the map for a new city
features.hints: The arcade Hint names what the next goal needs
features.reduced-motion: Follows the browser's reduced-motion setting (pieces land without the pop animation)
